title: ReseedSilo does not initialize global total stalk to the sum of reseeded account stalk
description: reseedSiloDeposit writes per-account stalk and per-token global deposited/depositedBdv, but does not accumulate a protocol-wide total stalk. If the system-wide total stalk used by earned-Bean distribution and governance is not set elsewhere in the reseed sequence to match the issued account stalk, global vs summed stalk diverge.
impact: If total stalk is mis-initialized, earned-Bean distribution (divides by total stalk) and governance quorum are mis-scaled. Needs confirmation of where total stalk is set across the full reseed (e.g. ReseedSun/InitalizeDiamond). Medium pending that trace.

ite.intent: Global total stalk equals the sum of all account stalk after reseed
ite.technique: Per-account writes without a corresponding global total update in this contract

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.sys.silo.stalk (potentially uninitialized/stale relative to sum of accounts)
ice_chain.consumer_function: earned-Bean distribution and governance weight read total stalk
ice_chain.impact: Mis-scaled yield/quorum if total not reconciled
ice_chain.exploit_path: reseed issues account stalk -> global total not set here -> distribution math divides by wrong total
